submitted.rationale: Across 5 EQE measurements, the highest EQE was at index 3 (Sb 0.19): 0.098%. Neighbours were lower: Sb 0.12 gave 0.063%, Sb 0.23 gave 0.073%, Sb 0.46 gave 0.016% and Sb 0.71 gave 0.005%. So EQE peaks sharply on the Fe-rich side, around Sb ≈ 0.19. XRD at Sb 0.19, 0.25 and 0.33 gave the same peak set (Q 1.878, 2.37, 2.65, 3.56 1/Å). That suggests one crystalline phase across this range, possibly a rutile-type Fe–Sb oxide, though I did not confirm this against reference patterns. The trend therefore appears to come from composition or defect effects, not a phase change.
